test_title: PYST 142: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 31 Jan, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some watches are clocks.

All clocks are black.

All black are big.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some watches are big.

II. Some watches are black.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99c86c211211a26c464f39618cfceb136c1af0a3ac02588becfb29b59841f48c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some watches are big → Follow (As, some watches are clocks, all clocks are black and all black are big. So, as clocks has some part common with watches and whole comes in black which whole comes in big, therefore it is definitely true.)

II. Some watches are black → Follow (As, some watches are clocks and all clocks are black. So, whole clocks comes in black and has some part common with watches therefore it is definitely true.)

So, Both conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Both conclusions I and II follow**".
